verdict_reason: `_pl_mle_alpha_ks` no longer computes the Clauset-Shalizi-Newman MLE that Martin-Mahoney HT-SR and released WeightWatcher define. Line 82 substitutes the bias-corrected numerator `(n_tail - 1)` whenever the CANDIDATE tail holds fewer than 20 points; CSN Eq. 3.1 and WW `fit_power_law_standard` use plain `n_tail` at every candidate, and WW's `(n-1)` branch is gated on the TOTAL eigenvalue count N < 20 (SMALL_N_CUTOFF, WW_powerlaw.py:26,69) with k_min=8 and selection on J = D_KS - 0.868/sqrt(n), none of which is present. I transcribed the identical scan with plain `n` and it reproduces live WWFit to mean 3.634e-15 / max 1.243e-14 over ALL 49 gpt2 linear modules and 1.243e-15 / 6.217e-15 over all 25 pythia-70m modules, so every other element is exact; the SHIPPED code diverges by mean |dalpha| 0.266328 / max 6.639792 on gpt2. Counterexample: gpt2 `transformer.h.5.attn.c_attn`, BLME alpha=9.631823 at n_tail=9 versus Clauset/WW alpha=2.992031 at n_tail=144 (+221.9%), which crosses Martin-Mahoney's own well-trained band alpha in [2,6]. Aggregates move avg_alpha_official 4.170866 vs 3.904538 (+6.82%) and avg_alpha_hat 11.744117 vs 11.100883 (+5.79%) on gpt2; 4.444830 vs 4.127582 (+7.69%) on pythia-70m. MECHANISM: the (n-1) numerator lowers alpha on short-tail candidates, lowering their fitted CDF and hence their KS, so the KS-argmin is systematically pulled to short tails; at n_tail=2 it produces a DATA-INDEPENDENT KS of exactly 1 - e^-1 - 0.5 = 0.132120559 (verified identical for tails [1,2], [1,1e6], [1,1.0001], [3.7,900]), so any spectrum whose genuine best KS exceeds 0.1321 collapses onto a two-point fit -- lambda = (100..1)^2 returns alpha=50.749581 at n_tail=2. Under plain `n` that same candidate has a constant KS of 0.364665 and effectively never wins. TO RETURN GREEN, exactly one thing must change: delete the branch at spectral.py:82 (`_num = n_tail`), or port WW's small-N branch verbatim (gate on total N < 20, k_min=8, argmin over J). Everything else I tested is already faithful and should not be touched.
